description: Source file implementing functions for the Cell_SPM class, related to diffusion calculations, overpotential, surface concentration, and molar flux in a battery simulation context.

classes.name: Cell_SPM
classes.description: Class representing a battery cell with methods for diffusion, surface concentration, overpotential, and flux calculations.

methods.name: calcSurfaceConcentration
methods.description: Calculates surface concentrations at positive and negative particles based on fluxes and diffusion constants.

methods.name: calcOverPotential
methods.description: Calculates overpotentials at positive and negative electrodes using the Bulter-Volmer equation.

methods.name: calcMolarFlux
methods.description: Calculates molar fluxes for positive and negative particles based on current density.

methods.name: calcDiffConstant
methods.description: Calculates diffusion constants at the battery temperature using Arrhenius relation.
